t: 当月早些时候教皇利奥三世去世后,选举了教皇斯蒂芬四世.
te: Election of pope Stephen IV following the death of pope Leo III earlier that month.
dz: 当月早些时候教皇利奥三世去世后,选举了教皇斯蒂芬四世.
de: Election of pope Stephen IV following the death of pope Leo III earlier that month.

t: 虔诚之王路易被教宗加冕为神圣罗马帝国皇帝.
te: King Louis the Pious is crowned emperor of the Holy Roman Empire by the Pope.
dz: 虔诚之王路易被教宗加冕为神圣罗马帝国皇帝.
de: King Louis the Pious is crowned emperor of the Holy Roman Empire by the Pope.
